devdoc.details: Inherits from SingleStrategyVault to provide core vault functionalities.

CallerNotController().details: This error ensures that only the authorized controller can execute sensitive vault management functions

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

ControllerDeposit(uint256).details: This event is triggered when the controller deposits assets into the vault for rebalancing operations or following rewards swapping activities

params.assets: The amount of assets deposited into the vault

ControllerWithdraw(address,uint256,addre.details: This event is triggered when the controller initiates a withdrawal for rebalancing operations or rewards swapping activities

params.asset: The address of the asset withdrawn (can be a reward token)
params.assets: The amount of assets withdrawn from the vault
params.receiver: The address that received the withdrawn assets

Deposit(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: This event follows the ERC7575 standard for deposit operations

params.assets: The amount of underlying assets deposited
params.owner: The address that will own the minted shares (same as receiver in this implementation)
params.sender: The address that initiated the deposit transaction
params.shares: The amount of shares minted (calculated using dynamic pricing)

Withdraw(address,address,address,uint256.details: This event follows the ERC7575 standard for withdrawal operations

params.assets: The amount of underlying assets withdrawn
params.owner: The address that owns the shares being redeemed
params.receiver: The address that receives the withdrawn assets
params.sender: The address that initiated the withdrawal transaction
params.shares: The amount of shares burned (calculated using dynamic pricing)

allocate(uint256).details: Only callable by the manager. Deposits assets into the strategy and receives strategy shares

params.assets: The amount of assets to allocate to the strategy

returns.shares: The number of strategy shares received in return

asset().details: Each vault manages a single underlying asset token

returns._0: The address of the underlying asset ERC20 contract

controller().details: The controller has special privileges to perform operations like rebalancing

returns._0: The address of the controller contract

controllerDeposit(uint256).custom:security: Access restricted to controller only to prevent unauthorized asset manipulation
controllerDeposit(uint256).details: This function can only be called by the designated controller contract. It's used during rebalancing operations to allocate assets that are already present in the vault. The controller is expected to transfer the assets into the vault before calling this function. The function executes any necessary post-deposit hooks to properly allocate the assets. Requirements: - Can only be called by the controller contract Emits: - {ControllerDeposit} event with the deposited asset amount

params.assets: The amount of assets to deposit (in asset's native decimals)

controllerWithdraw(address,uint256,addre.custom:security: Access restricted to controller only to prevent unauthorized asset drainage
controllerWithdraw(address,uint256,addre.details: This function can only be called by the designated controller contract. It's used during rebalancing operations to redistribute assets across different vaults in the protocol. The function executes any necessary pre-withdrawal hooks. Requirements: - Can only be called by the controller contract - Vault must have sufficient assets to transfer Emits: - {ControllerWithdraw} event with the withdrawn asset amount

params.asset_: The address of the asset to withdraw (can be a reward token)
params.assets: The amount of assets to withdraw (in asset's native decimals)
params.receiver: The address that will receive the withdrawn assets

convertToAssets(uint256).details: In this implementation, shares are 1:1 with normalized assets (18 decimals) due to missing dynamic pricing context that would be required for more complex calculations

params.shares: The amount of shares to convert (normalized 18 decimals)

returns._0: The equivalent amount of assets (in asset's native decimals)

convertToShares(uint256).details: In this implementation, shares are 1:1 with normalized assets (18 decimals) due to missing dynamic pricing context that would be required for more complex calculations

params.assets: The amount of assets to convert (in asset's native decimals)

returns._0: The equivalent amount of shares (normalized to 18 decimals)

deallocate(uint256).details: Only callable by the manager. Withdraws assets from the strategy back to the vault

params.assets: The amount of assets to withdraw from the strategy

returns.shares: The number of strategy shares burned in the process

deposit(uint256,address).details: Transfers assets from the caller, normalizes the amount, and delegates to the controller for share minting. The controller handles the actual share token minting and any cross-vault considerations like dynamic pricing. Requirements: - Caller must have approved this contract to spend `assets` amount - `assets` must not exceed the maximum deposit limit Emits: - {Deposit} event with the deposit details

params.assets: The amount of assets to deposit (in asset's native decimals)
params.receiver: The address that will receive the minted shares

returns.shares: The amount of shares minted (normalized to 18 decimals)

returns._0: The address authorized to manage vault operations

maxDeposit(address).details: Delegates to the controller which considers protocol-wide limits, vault capacity, and any receiver-specific restrictions. Result is denormalized to asset's native decimals.

params.receiver: The address that would receive the minted shares

returns.assets: The maximum amount of assets that can be deposited (in asset's native decimals)

maxMint(address).details: Delegates to the controller which considers protocol-wide limits, vault capacity, and any receiver-specific restrictions.

params.receiver: The address that would receive the minted shares

returns.shares: The maximum amount of shares that can be minted (normalized to 18 decimals)

maxRedeem(address).details: Considers both the controller's limits and the vault's available asset liquidity. The available assets limit how many shares can actually be redeemed for assets.

params.owner: The address that owns the shares

returns.shares: The maximum amount of shares that can be redeemed (normalized to 18 decimals)

maxWithdraw(address).details: Considers both the controller's limits and the vault's available asset liquidity. The available assets include both vault balance and any immediately accessible assets from strategies.

params.owner: The address that owns the shares

returns.assets: The maximum amount of assets that can be withdrawn (in asset's native decimals)

mint(uint256,address).details: Calculates the required assets through the controller, then transfers assets from the caller. The controller handles the actual share token minting. Assets are calculated using ceiling rounding, which ensures that for any non-zero shares input, the calculated assets will also be non-zero, preventing free share minting. Requirements: - Caller must have approved this contract to spend the calculated `assets` amount - `shares` must not exceed the maximum mint limit Emits: - {Deposit} event with the deposit details

params.receiver: The address that will receive the minted shares
params.shares: The amount of shares to mint (normalized to 18 decimals)

returns.assets: The amount of assets deposited (in asset's native decimals)

previewDeposit(uint256).details: Simulates a deposit operation without executing it. Normalizes the asset amount and delegates to the controller for share calculation based on current pricing.

params.assets: The amount of assets to preview depositing (in asset's native decimals)

returns.shares: The amount of shares that would be minted (normalized to 18 decimals)

previewMint(uint256).details: Simulates a mint operation without executing it. Delegates to the controller for asset calculation based on current pricing, then denormalizes the result.

params.shares: The amount of shares to preview minting (normalized to 18 decimals)

returns.assets: The amount of assets that would be required (in asset's native decimals)

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Simulates a redemption operation without executing it. Delegates to the controller for asset calculation based on current pricing, then denormalizes the result.

params.shares: The amount of shares to preview redeeming (normalized to 18 decimals)

returns.assets: The amount of assets that would be withdrawn (in asset's native decimals)

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Simulates a withdrawal operation without executing it. Normalizes the asset amount and delegates to the controller for share calculation based on current pricing.

params.assets: The amount of assets to preview withdrawing (in asset's native decimals)

returns.shares: The amount of shares that would be burned (normalized to 18 decimals)

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Burns shares from the owner through the controller, calculates the assets to withdraw, then transfers assets to the receiver. Requirements: - If caller is not the owner, they must have sufficient allowance - `shares` must not exceed the maximum redemption limit - Vault must have sufficient available assets Emits: - {Withdraw} event with the withdrawal details

params.owner: The address that owns the shares being burned
params.receiver: The address that will receive the withdrawn assets
params.shares: The amount of shares to redeem (normalized to 18 decimals)

returns.assets: The amount of assets withdrawn (in asset's native decimals)

setAutoAllocationThreshold(uint256).details: Only callable by the manager. When deposits exceed this threshold, assets are automatically allocated to the strategy

params.threshold: The minimum deposit amount that triggers automatic allocation

share().details: All vaults share the same share token as their share representation

returns._0: The address of the share token contract managed by the controller
The address of the strategy contract

totalAssets().details: Includes both assets held directly in the vault and any additional assets managed through strategies or other mechanisms (via `_additionalOwnedAssets`)

returns._0: The total amount of assets in the asset's native decimal precision

totalNormalizedAssets().details: Normalized assets are standardized to 18 decimals regardless of the underlying asset's actual decimal places. Used for consistent cross-vault calculations

returns._0: The total normalized asset amount (always in 18 decimals)

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Burns shares from the owner through the controller, then transfers assets to the receiver. Handles any necessary asset rebalancing through hooks. Requirements: - If caller is not the owner, they must have sufficient allowance - `assets` must not exceed the maximum withdrawal limit - Vault must have sufficient available assets Emits: - {Withdraw} event with the withdrawal details

params.assets: The amount of assets to withdraw (in asset's native decimals)
params.owner: The address that owns the shares being burned
params.receiver: The address that will receive the withdrawn assets

returns.shares: The amount of shares burned (normalized to 18 decimals)
